makemeahanzi.definition: to crouch, to crawl, to lie hidden, to conceal

etymology.hint: A person 亻 acting like a dog 犬

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 伏 describes a person's posture, crouched low to the ground.
犬 (dog) — paired with the person 亻, the image of someone lying low like a dog gave 伏 its meaning 'to crouch, to lie hidden.'
⺮ (bamboo) — 篮 names an object often woven from bamboo, a basket.
监 (jiān) gives a sound only distantly related to lán today, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to accuse; to assault; to criticize

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (an action/to strike) — 攻 relates directly to attacking or striking
工 (gōng) gives the sound — 攻 is also pronounced gōng, an exact match

etymology.hint: A man bringing home meat ⺼ for the family 户

characterDeckComponents.note: 户 (door, household) — 肩 relates to a family member returning home.
⺼ (flesh/body) — meat carried home over one's 肩 (shoulder) gave the character its meaning.

makemeahanzi.definition: to persistently exhort or urge; sting (as of an insect)

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 叮 relates to biting or speaking.
丁 (dīng) gives the sound — an exact match with 叮.

meanings: sixth of the ten Heavenly Stems 十天干[shi2 tian1 gan1]

makemeahanzi.definition: self, oneself; personal, private; 6th heavenly stem

characterDeckComponents.note: 己 is thought to depict a woven cord or thread pattern, though its exact original picture is debated; it came to be used for the reflexive idea of 'oneself.'

etymology.hint: Vines growing with a melon at their base

characterDeckComponents.note: Represents the round shape of a melon hanging on the vine.

makemeahanzi.definition: to take out; to pull out; to clean out

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 掏 describes reaching in and pulling something out by hand.
匋 (táo) gives the sound — an exact match with 掏, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: agent, go-between, intermediary; to introduce; shell, armor

etymology.hint: A border 八 dividing people 人

characterDeckComponents.note: 人 (person) forms the top of the character.
八, shown here as a dividing line, suggests separation or a boundary — together with 人 above, giving 介 its meaning 'to lie between, to introduce.'
鬼 (ghost/spirit) — 魂 names a person's spirit or soul.
云 (yún) gives a rhyme close to hún, with a different initial.

meanings: key (on a piano or computer keyboard)
button (on a mouse or other device)

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) — 键 originally named a metal bolt or pin, extending to a mechanical 'key.'
建 (jiàn) gives the sound — an exact match with 键.
心 (heart/mind) — 忠 describes a heart that stays true, loyalty.
中 (zhōng) is an exact match for the sound of 忠.

etymology.hint: Hand 寸 holding meat ⺼ over an altar 示

characterDeckComponents.note: Altar — represents a place for worship or ritual.
Meat held by a hand, offered during the ceremony.
Water — 浅 originally described shallow water.
Gives the sound qiǎn, matching the character's reading.

makemeahanzi.definition: to look back; to look at; to look after

characterDeckComponents.note: 页 (head) — 顾 originally related to turning the head to look back at something
厄 (è) gives a sound distantly related to 顾's reading gù, having drifted apart over time
⺼ (flesh/body) — 胆 names a body organ, the gallbladder.
旦 (dàn) gives a sound close to dǎn, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to injure, to ruin, to spoil; cruel, oppressive, savage; disabled, incomplete

characterDeckComponents.note: 歹 (death/bad) — 残 relates to damage, destruction, and injury.
戋 (jiān) gives a sound distantly related to cán, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to attack, to beat, to hit, to strike

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 扑 describes striking or pouncing with the hand.
卜 shares a bilabial initial (b/p) with pū, though the rhyme has drifted from o to ū over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to drift, to float, to flutter

characterDeckComponents.note: 风 (wind) — 飘 describes something fluttering or floating on the wind.
票 (piào) gives a sound very close to piāo, sharing the initial and rhyme — only the tone differs.

makemeahanzi.definition: a treasure, a precious thing; rare, valuable

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (jade, written as the radical for 玉) — 珍 names something precious, like a valuable jewel.
彡 (shān) gives a sound distantly related to zhēn, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to visit; to inquire, to ask

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 访 relates to visiting someone to speak with them or ask questions.
方 (fāng) gives a sound distantly related to fǎng, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: imperial decree; to summon, to call, to beckon

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 召 describes calling out to summon someone.
刀 (dāo) gives a rhyme close to zhào, with a different initial.

makemeahanzi.definition: thirsty, parched; to yearn, to pine for

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — thirst is a need for water.
曷 (hé) gives a sound close in rhyme to kě, though the initial consonant has drifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: class, category, type; family; affiliated, belonging to

characterDeckComponents.note: 尸 (body) — ties to 属's sense of belonging to a category or class of related things
禹 (yǔ) gives a loose sound connection to 属's reading shǔ
木 (wood) — axe handles, stalks, and boughs are all made of or belong to wood.
可 (kě) gives the sound — a close match for kē, differing only in tone.

meanings: surname (as in 王氏[Wang2 shi4] "the Wang clan")
née (as in 李王氏[Li3 Wang2 shi4] "Mrs. Li, née Wang")

characterDeckComponents.note: 氏 is traditionally read as a picture of a person bent over — the image behind its meaning 'clan, family name.'
力 (strength) shows 勤 relates to effort applied to work.
堇 (jǐn) gives a sound distantly related to qín, having drifted apart over time.
女 (woman) — 姐 names a female relative, an older sister.
且 (qiě) gives the rhyme, close to jiě though the tone differs.
钅 (metal) — 铐 names metal shackles or handcuffs.
考 (kǎo) gives a sound close to 铐's reading kào, differing only in tone.

etymology.hint: The thunderous sound of a pair 双 of carts 车

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (a cart) — a rumbling vehicle.
双 (a pair) — two such carts together, their combined noise giving 轰 its meaning 'rumble, boom, to bombard.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to examine, to investigate; to judge; to try

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — 审 relates to a formal setting, like a courtroom, where matters are examined
申 (shēn) gives a sound close to 审's reading shěn, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: to cross, to ferry over, to pass through

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 渡 describes crossing over a body of water.
度 (dù) gives the sound — an exact match with 渡.
阝 (mound, place) shows 邮 relates to stations along a route, the origin of its postal meaning.
由 (yóu) gives the exact sound of 邮.
Bow — original sense of a strung bow, later extended to 'full/filled.'
Gives the sound ěr, related to mí but drifted apart over time.
见 (to see) — 靓 relates to appearance — to make up one's face so as to look attractive.
青 (qīng) is close to the sound of 靓, but not an exact match.

meanings: classifier for bunches, bundles, beams of light etc

makemeahanzi.definition: to bind, to control, to restrain; bale

etymology.hint: Lumber 木 bound by rope 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — 束 depicts a bundle of wood.
口 here depicts a rope or band wrapped around the wood, binding it together, giving 束 its meaning 'to bind, a bundle.'

etymology.hint: To verbally 讠 confirm 矣 ; 矣 also provides the pronunciation
To walk 彳 as required by law 聿

characterDeckComponents.note: 彳 (to walk/step) — represents movement or conduct.
聿 (an old form related to a writing brush) — conduct guided by written rules gave 律 its meaning 'law, regulation.'
予 (to give) — 幻 is drawn as an inverted, mirror-image form of 予, picturing something turned upside down or not as it seems, giving 幻 its meaning 'illusion, fantasy.'
The three vertical strokes trace the flowing lines of a river between its banks.

makemeahanzi.definition: to dredge up; to fish for; to scoop out of the water

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 捞 is an action done by hand.
劳 (láo) gives a sound close to lāo, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to straddle, to ride; to span, to stretch across

characterDeckComponents.note: Foot — striding is a leg/foot movement.
Gives the sound kuā, related to kuà but drifted apart over time.
衤 (clothing) — 裙 names a garment, a skirt.
君 (jūn) gives a sound close to qún, sharing the rhyme with a different initial.

etymology.hint: A public 官 building where food 饣 is served; 官 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 饣 (food) points to a place where meals are served.
官 pictures an official hall or residence, giving 馆 its sense of a large public building.
口 (mouth) — 嗷 describes a loud crying or wailing sound.
敖 (áo) gives an exact match for 嗷's reading.
冏 depicts brightness, an open window; its link to 裔's meaning 'descendants' has faded over time, a common pattern in characters whose original imagery no longer maps clearly onto the current meaning.
衣 (yī) gives a sound close to 裔's reading yì, differing only in tone.

etymology.hint: Birds 隹 caught in a sudden storm 雨

characterDeckComponents.note: 雨 (rain) — 霍 pictures a sudden downpour.
隹 (a short-tailed bird) — birds startled and scattered by a sudden storm of rain 雨 gave 霍 its meaning 'suddenly, quickly.'
黑 (black) — 黛 names a dark pigment.
代 (dài) gives the sound — an exact match with 黛.

makemeahanzi.definition: vessel, craft; to sail, to navigate

characterDeckComponents.note: 舟 (boat) — 航 relates to traveling by boat, and later by extension, air or space travel
亢 (kàng) gives a sound distantly related to 航's reading háng, having drifted apart over time
